name: Grilly Cheese
short_description: Sourdough, brioche, aged Gruyère — every sandwich is a reason to come back.
description: There are grilled cheese sandwiches, and then there's Grilly Cheese. Built on thick-cut artisan bread — sourdough, brioche, or seeded rye sourced fresh from local bakeries — every sandwich at this Philadelphia-area staple showcases what happens when a simple format is taken seriously. The cheese selection alone sets it apart: aged Gruyère, tangy taleggio, creamy brie, and sharp provolone, each melted to golden bubbly perfection on a flat-top griddle. The rotating lineup of house-made add-ins is what earns the repeat visits — caramelized onion jam, truffle aioli, roasted tomatoes, seasonal specials that change by the month. The signature 'Grilly Deluxe' with bacon, fig spread, and aged cheddar is a near-religious experience. Grilly Cheese is a consistent presence at South Jersey corporate catering events, private parties, and festivals from Cherry Hill to Cape May — call ahead or book online and they'll be at your next event.

name: A Taste of Philly

description: A Taste of Philly has been working the Camden County circuit long enough to know what South Jersey wants in a cheesesteak: thinly shaved ribeye griddled to order, a fresh Amoroso roll, and no compromises on the cheese. Provolone, American, or Cheez Whiz — the truck does all three right. Beyond the signature steak, the Italian hoagie piled with quality deli meats and the rotating seasonal board keep regulars checking back. Corporate lunch crews in Cherry Hill, block parties in Voorhees and Haddonfield, and weekend festivals in Collingswood are all A Taste of Philly territory. description: Korean, Japanese, and Southeast Asian BBQ traditions get blended into something genuinely original at Big D's Grub — Cape May County's standout fusion truck on the shore circuit from spring through fall. Jasmine rice bowls anchored with smoky caramelized protein (bulgogi beef, teriyaki chicken, char siu pork) come topped with a fried egg, pickled cucumber, and house chili oil in a format that holds its own against any sit-down restaurant. Vegetarian guests have a dedicated protein swap. The truck works Cape May City and the broader shore festival circuit, and is well-suited for boardwalk events, outdoor weddings, and private parties throughout Cape May County and the Atlantic City corridor. name: Dos Hermanos Tacos
short_description: Six years on the Camden County circuit, still drawing lines — trompo al pastor tells the story.
description: Six years on the Camden County farmers market circuit and Dos Hermanos Tacos still draws a line. The Haddonfield-based family operation has built its following one taco at a time, and the difference in quality is immediately apparent. Al pastor is marinated overnight in achiote and citrus, then carved fresh off a traditional trompo — not every truck does this, and most guests can taste why it matters. Carnitas are braised low and slow in their own fat with orange and bay leaf until golden and falling apart. Handmade corn tortillas, three fresh salsas made daily, and birria served consommé-style with dipping broth round out a menu as close to Mexico City street food as South Jersey gets. Book via Instagram or website for private events throughout Camden County.

Fresh pico de gallo, roasted salsa roja, house guacamole, pickled jalapeños, and crema complete the builds into burritos, bowls, and tacos. description: The flavor menu at Milk + Sugar rotates weekly and follows what's actually happening in South Jersey farms at any given moment — fresh strawberry and rhubarb in late spring, fig and honey in August, apple cider in fall, blood orange and vanilla when winter sets in. description: Venezuelan-style arepas — thick griddled corn cakes split and packed with fresh fillings — have built a passionate following for MozzArepas across the Camden County market and festival circuit. Pernil (slow-roasted pork shoulder), shredded beef in savory sofrito, and a fully vegetarian option with roasted vegetables and queso blanco round out the menu. What makes the format stick is the texture: a crispy exterior and soft steamed interior unlike any other street food format on the South Jersey circuit. Each arepa is cooked to order. Cherry Hill is home base; the truck is available for private events, cultural festivals, corporate catering, and community gatherings throughout Camden County. Contact via Instagram or website.

name: Pitruco Pizza
short_description: Neapolitan-certified wood-fired pizza from Philadelphia — one of South Jersey's most-booked event trucks.
description: Pitruco Pizza is a Philadelphia-based Neapolitan wood-fired pizza operation that has become one of the most-booked event trucks in the South Jersey region. The centerpiece is a custom-built wood-fired brick oven mounted on a trailer, capable of reaching the 900°F temperatures that produce a true Neapolitan crust — airy, blistered, slightly charred at the cornicione, tender through the center. Dough ferments for a minimum of 48 hours; ingredients meet Italian Neapolitan certification standards: San Marzano D.O.P. tomatoes, buffalo mozzarella, fresh basil. Pitruco operates out of Philadelphia and covers South Jersey events extensively — Burlington County, Camden County, and Gloucester County are all within their regular range. South Jersey weddings, corporate events, and community festivals are a strong fit, with the wood-fired oven serving as both cooking apparatus and visual centerpiece. Book via website or Instagram well in advance; summer weekend dates fill quickly.

name: Sum Pig

description: Woodbury's most serious BBQ operation does Carolina-style whole-hog in a region that understands low-and-slow and demands it done right. The pig is cooked overnight over hardwood coals, then hand-pulled into the vinegar-slaw-topped portions that define Eastern Carolina BBQ — smoky, tender, and intensely flavored in a way that immediately separates this from the sauced-up pulled pork at lesser operations. Alongside the whole-hog centerpiece: ribs, smoked sausage, hush puppies, and pit beans slow-cooked in the smoker. Sum Pig works Woodbury and across Gloucester County and is a top-tier option for outdoor festivals, block parties in Deptford and Washington Township, and private catering for events where BBQ is the main attraction. description: East Los Angeles street taco culture has arrived in Camden, and Taco Angeleno executes it with the authenticity the format demands. The birria quesatacos are the must-order: slow-braised beef birria folded into a cheese-crisped tortilla and served with a rich consommé for dipping — messy, deeply satisfying, and unlike anything else on the local scene. Carne asada is griddled to order over high heat and dressed with charred salsa verde and white onion. The Mexican-Korean section — kalbi short rib tacos and kimchi-loaded asada fries — has generated real social media attention and attracted adventurous eaters from across Camden County. description: Cape May's most welcoming taqueria on wheels earns its regulars by being exactly what a taco truck should be: consistent, proud, and focused. description: Weckerly's is a Philadelphia artisan ice cream institution with a strong seasonal presence on the Cape May County shore circuit.
